review_method: Actual Codex in-app browser screenshots and SVG DOM text bounds. Review pages embed the produced SVG; local views change only viewBox.
observations: The certified addition and normalization now form a named intermediate stage while original branch computations remain outside.
The same recipe handles independent vector tails, chained tails and a BatchNorm2d convolutional residual.
Unknown calls and escaping intermediate values remain independent; unaffected residual tails can still form stages.
Conditional interiors cannot form stages; their true/false boundaries and joins remain in the graph.
The actual editor exposes both original operations on expansion, preserves bindings through save/reopen/refold, and expands every stage with Expand all.
The Transformer frontier exposes five stages for the concrete representative layers; width 2588px and 57 crossings are unchanged, height falls from 4730 to 4502px.
The dedicated expanded reference remains substantially more compact and better organized; full role/frontier correspondence remains unverified.
tradeoffs: Opening one Transformer stage increases the whole graph from 100 nodes / 106 edges to 102 / 107 and raises crossings from 57 to 81, height 4502 to 5456px. Existing routing gates pass, but this is a real detail-layout regression.

The conditional fixture has a different automatic frontier: an independent stage forms while true/false regions stay folded. Local budget/unwrap selection is sensitive to presentation grouping; atomic detail and one bypass constraint are deferred.
TailMosaic and InterruptedTail each retain one pre-existing final bypass channel conflict. A stage references the final constraint receipt instead of duplicating a preliminary applied status.
Compatible sibling operations and a direct single-use intermediate are required. Aliased/indirect tails retain their existing representation.
